Subject: Nov dashboard: cost spike on long-tail + QBR prep

Karthik — attaching the November dashboard snapshot and a short note on anomalies we should track for next week's QBR. High-level: 

- Cost: per-token unit cost shows an ~18% increase driven by long-tail (>512 token) requests; these are ~7% of requests but 30% of token spend.
- Latency: p95 for small models in eu-west spiked from 220ms -> 480ms over the last 10 days; p50 unchanged.
- Uptime: slight regression 99.93% -> 99.89% for the last 30 days (mostly transient infra errors).
- Usage: overall request volume flat; new customers are skewing toward longer context usage.

Ask: can we triage the cost/latency tail and produce a one-page summary for the QBR (due COB Nov 24)? Prefer owners: triage (Jonas), cost analysis (Stephanie), deck slide (Laura). If owners differ, call it out and I will reassign.

Attached: 20261118-nov-dashboard.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB)

Thanks —

2) KV/prefix cache audit: compare cache-hit by customer cohort; look for recent regressed TTLs or invalidation spikes.

4) Mini canary: if caching or batching looks suspect, deploy a conservative change to a small customer cohort and compare cost/latency delta.

Estimated timeline: data-backed hypotheses in ~18 hours; mitigation options + runbook in ~48 hours. Requesting infra logs from Oliver and the ops team (details: request id HUBSPOT-12345). Attaching the triage checklist I'll use.
